average_cost.description: The average cost of inventory available to sell.

deleted_at.description: The deletion timestamp in UTC, or null if not deleted.

outlet_id.description: The ID of the outlet associated with this inventory record.

product_id.description: The ID of the product associated with this inventory record.

quantity_to_procure.description: Quantity of stock to procure in order to satisfy current fulfilments and service orders.

reorder_amount.description: The quantity to order to reach the desired stock level. For the `FIXED` method, this is a static amount that was set when the reorder method was configured. For `MIN_MAX`, this is dynamically computed as the difference between reorder_target and current_inventory_level, or zero if current stock exceeds the target. This computation is independent of reorder_point and may produce a non-zero value even when current_inventory_level is above the reorder point. It is null if no reorder method is configured.

reorder_method.description: The reorder strategy in use. Either `FIXED` or `MIN_MAX`. Null if no reorder method is configured.

reorder_point.description: The inventory level at which a product should be automatically included in stock orders.

reorder_target.description: The desired stock level to restore to when reordering. For reorder_method `MIN_MAX`, this is the target the reorder amount is computed against. For `FIXED`, this equals reorder_point + reorder_amount. Null if no reorder method is configured.
